FULL TEXT:
TRANSLATOR AND TRANSLATOR-CUM-PROOF READER (FOR SUVAS CELL)
RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 72 /R&A Dated: 26th Sep, 2025
In continuation to this Court’s Notice No. 62/R&A dated 02.09.2025 whereby Shri Amresh
Kumar (Roll No.100464) was granted a last chance to report for joining to the post of Translator
(SUVAS Cell) by 14.09.2025, it is hereby notified that the Hon’ble Court have been pleased to cancel his
selection/appointment on account of his non-joining within the time period of last chance (i.e. by
14.09.2025) granted to him.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
